title: Sebulba
description: Sebulba was a Dug who walked on his hands and controlled his Podracer with his feet—a quirk of his species. Aggressive and ruthless, he wasn't above cheating and sabotage to win races, even if it meant breaking the pods of opponents like Anakin Skywalker. It was his ruthlessness that made him a favorite of the fans of Podracing on Tatooine. At the Boonta Eve Podrace, he was the favorite to win—Anakin Skywalker hadn't even finished a race before—but when it came between the two of them, neck and neck at the end, Sebulba couldn't pull ahead.
